hook_line: ANUPAMA RAMACHANDRAN DEFENDS WORLD SNOOKER TITLE IN INDORE

hook_stat.sub: Final score as Anupama Ramachandran beat So Man Yan to retain her IBSF World Snooker Championship title

news_summary: Anupama Ramachandran beat Hong Kong China's So Man Yan 3-1 in Indore on Saturday to retain her IBSF World Snooker Championship title.
payoff: She is the first Indian to win back-to-back world snooker crowns.
